title: English or Spanish?
blurb: Two options, both of them wrong, and no time whatsoever to think about it. The interrogation format took off because it weaponises a completely reasonable question — the pressure comes from the delivery, not the content, and the correct answer is that there is no correct answer. It has since become the internet's favourite way to demand a response from somebody who was not expecting to be asked anything. Play it before putting any question to anyone at all. The panic in the pause is the point of the entire exercise.
origin: From the viral 'English or Spanish' interrogation prank format.
